title: •Han Solo
caption: •Han Solo (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}, 4: _Falcon_. Cards with “Han” in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett or Jabba’s game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated a battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.
lore: Smuggler, gambler and “freelance law-bender.” Crafty Corellian pirate. Rebel hero. Owns _Millennium Falcon_. Co-pilot Chewbacca promised him “life-debt.” Has bounty on head.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); deploy 3 / forfeit 6. Icon column: pilot, warrior. Rebel. Inline pilot icon + '3, 4: Falcon' → {pilot:3}, 4: _Falcon_ (stub expands it). Curly quotes “Han” and Jabba’s. Slip text matches the stub otherwise. The wiki's default 'Han Solo' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Han Solo (Original)'. The 745 px Premiere-L-hansolo.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face; it prints Smuggler and gambler bold) — downloaded to src/vs10/04-Premiere-L-hansolo.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan (printed face) is src, where no bold is discernible, so no bold marked. Lore corrected from the scans: curly double quotes “freelance law-bender.” and “life-debt.” (wiki straight single) and _Millennium Falcon_ italic (wiki plain). Copyright 1995 legible on the 745 face. Modern: V24-L-hansolo.gif (745 px) is a LATER PC Han Solo (V) (Virtual Set 24, different game text/stats) — same printed art, art only; VB1-L-hansolo(-pre).gif (347 px) is this slip reissued (its text still reads 'Boba Fett’s or Jabba’s' and 'initiated battle'), not downloaded.
